related_issues.reason: Build tempdir is created inside the uv cache (builds-v0), causing sdist/wheel builds to fail when the cache sits on NFS. Same cache-as-build-location area, different failure mode.
Project/cache directory relationship: a UV_CACHE_DIR set inside the project changes dependency resolution. Shares the project-inside-cache topic but not the same symptom or request.

rationale: The reporter names the release that broke it (worked before uv 0.11.21, fails after the change from #19659), which is a strong bug signal per the playbook. The error is uv's own guard ('The project directory . is inside the cache directory'), raised when a hatchling build hook runs `uv export` from inside uv's sdist build directory in ~/.cache/uv. The message does not say what to change, so the rule-2 question exception does not apply. The cause is not external: the guard is in uv. Medium rather than high confidence because a maintainer could read the cache guard as intended and the hook as unsupported recursion. Searches for the exact error text and for the hatch-hook/export regression found no earlier duplicate. The docs search did not show any documented behaviour for building inside the cache, and I did not read the cache docs page.
